description: This file declares functions and data structures related to walking through reflogs in a version control system, likely Git. It includes initialization, release, adding entries, displaying messages, and retrieving reflog information functions.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog walk info structure.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with reflog walk info.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for the given commit and name to the walk.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays a reflog message with options for date formatting.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the reflog message into a string buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the reflog walk info.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a reflog selector string with options for date formatting and shortening.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk has no more entries.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Fetches the next reflog entry during the walk.
